weather.note: Open-Meteo emits 24 local-hour labels per calendar day even on DST switch days; the overlay joins on (local date, local hour) and never fabricates a 25th hour.

greenWindow.rule: The green window is computed from the trailing 30 days of hourly values (price and renewable share of generation), each hour independent. A green hour has price at or below the 30th percentile of the trailing price distribution AND renewable share at or above the 70th percentile of the trailing renewable-share distribution. A red hour is the exact inverse through the same code path: price at or above the 70th percentile AND renewable share at or below the 30th percentile. The rendered window is the hour interval (at least two contiguous wall-clock hours) that recurs most often as a whole: the number of trailing days on which every hour of the interval qualifies under the rule above. Ties prefer the longer interval, then the earliest start. Its frequency share is the share of trailing days on which the full interval qualifies. Hours qualifying outside the window still count in the frequency strip and the risk indicators individually. Percentiles use linear interpolation on the sorted hourly sample. Basis: renewable share of generation (NL generation mix); price is the NL day-ahead price. The strip can also mark one other recurring window: the strongest interval that qualifies on at least half as many days as the window and is separated from it by at least one hour. It is drawn fainter than the window and named with its opening share in the caption.

indicators.label: Negative-price hours
indicators.rule: Share of trailing-30-day hours with day-ahead price below 0 EUR/MWh. Watch at ≥ 1%, high at ≥ 5%.

indicators.label: Red-hour share
indicators.rule: Share of trailing-30-day hours qualifying as red hours under the green window rule (price ≥ 70th percentile AND renewable share of generation ≤ 30th percentile, same code path as the green window). Watch at ≥ 20%, high at ≥ 35%.

indicators.label: Load covered by net imports
indicators.rule: Over the trailing 30 days: Σ max(0, net physical import in GW × 1000) / Σ load in MW: the share of Dutch load covered by net imports (cross-border physical flows, imports positive). Watch at ≥ 25%, high at ≥ 40%.

indicators.label: Price spread (p90−p10)
indicators.rule: Trailing-30-day hourly price spread: 90th minus 10th percentile of day-ahead price, EUR/MWh. Watch at ≥ 150 EUR/MWh, high at ≥ 250 EUR/MWh.

indicators.label: Longest Dunkelflaute run
indicators.rule: Longest consecutive run of hours in the trailing 90 days with wind onshore + wind offshore + distribution-connected renewables below 20% of load. Watch at ≥ 24 h, high at ≥ 48 h.

risk.note: Indicators derived from open data; not a grid-security assessment.

scores.basis: renewable share of load, trailing 365 days, daily averages; nl from ENTSO-E Transparency Platform per-type data (A75/A65, processType A16, bidding zone 10YNL----------L), all other zones from energy-charts.info /v2/ren_share_daily_avg
scores.composition: score = 0.5 x mean daily renewable share of load + 0.5 x share of days with renewable share >= 50% (scaled to 0-100)
